sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 26 = check 25; Internal Quality Checks row 26; no cell comments on the row)
evidence: Static review of the frozen bytes; no configured LLM judge run exists (raw-evidence-index.json scope: scripted golden only), so actual judge compliance is unmeasured and run_verdict is NOT EXERCISED. All five prompts open with 'Evaluate the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP' (gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1, scored/visual/prompt.md:1), and each judge.toml wires the playwright MCP server (judge.toml:8-12 in all five). Not source: render 'Use only rendered browser behavior' (render/prompt.md:1); constraints 'Use only rendered browser behavior and the live DOM ... decide it from the listed DOM facts only, not from file names, bundled library names or how the code looks' (constraints/prompt.md:1,5); functional 'do not read implementation files to infer success' (functional/prompt.md:20); polish 'do not read implementation files' (polish/prompt.md:17); visual 'Do not read implementation files' (visual/prompt.md:18). Not memory: 'A criterion passes only on evidence you gathered yourself in this session' (functional/prompt.md:9, polish/prompt.md:9); visual 'Score from screenshots and the rendered page you observed yourself in this session' (visual/prompt.md:11). Not first paint: every scored prompt's gate requires typing into the editor and a Run producing preview output (functional/prompt.md:5, polish/prompt.md:5, visual/prompt.md:5); the render gate rejects 'a static shell whose editor cannot be typed into or whose Run does nothing' (render/prompt.md:5) and its criterion needs two typed Runs with different sums (render/judge.toml:23); visual requires a ten-line draft, a Run, a double-click selection and a two-second caret watch before screenshots (visual/prompt.md:12). Real input is required ('real key presses and clicks; do not dispatch synthetic events', render/prompt.md:5, constraints/prompt.md:5, functional/prompt.md:20, polish/prompt.md:17). All criteria in the five judge.toml files describe live interactions; none is decidable from a static page. Weak-app probe: a static screenshot-like shell or a page with canned preview text fails each gate because typed, judge-chosen integers/fixtures must be reflected after Run. Conforming-alternative probe: a canvas-drawn editor is handled by app_context.md:25 (read from screenshots), so browser-only grading stays feasible. Minor non-blocking observation: the two gate prompts rely on 'Use only rendered browser behavior' rather than an explicit 'do not read implementation files' sentence, and the visual prompt does not restate the real-key rule for its setup draft; both still confine evidence to the browser.
